earliest_divergence.detail: The second persisted row for seed 1000001 is byte-for-byte equal to the first row for that seed.

root_cause.description: The runner appended each completed row to games and base['games'], then assigned base['games'] = games. After the first iteration both names referenced the same list, so every subsequent row was appended twice.

impact: All calibration outcomes are inadmissible. The raw checkpoint is preserved and must not be salvaged.
correction: Use one authoritative row accumulator; append each row exactly once; checkpoint from an immutable snapshot or a separate copy; validate unique IDs, exact schedule cardinality, per-cell counts, orientation counts, and idempotent resume before publication.
